summary: ApoIcarus provides reusable highscore storage and descending-score presentation patterns, but its implementation is online-only and parses untrusted records without bounds or tuple validation. ApoMario already computes final points in ApoMarioLevel#setAnalysis(boolean), tracks elapsed time through getPassedTime(), derives player names in ApoMarioAnalysis#getName(ApoMarioPlayer), and displays final results in ApoMarioAnalysis#render(Graphics2D). The change should add a local file-backed ApoMarioHighscore boundary, connect run completion to that actual state, and add a menu panel while preserving record integrity and availability on invalid input.
